sin.name: counter-kept-on-an-object
sin.description: An object counts how often something happened in a field of its own. Each command line builds new objects, so the count is lost and the limit never comes.
sin.rule: Count with Countdowns.tick and a CountDown declaration: the count is kept in a row for the actor, and it can be silent, reset, or ended on a condition. Ticks, the database and the server's queue live in one long process and count no actor, so they are left out.
